name: expense-agent
description: Save receipts and purchases from chat, then review, edit, total and export your expenses.

interface.longDescription: Expense Tracker is a personal expense tracker: it records what you spend and helps you review it. Share a receipt, a photo of a bill, or just say "paid 450 for lunch at Truffles yesterday", and the merchant, date, amount, tax and category are saved to your own account. Open the interactive list to filter by month, category or text, fix any detail, or delete entries. Ask for totals by category or month, per currency (different currencies are never mixed), and export any range as CSV for your spreadsheet or accountant. Duplicate purchases are detected and skipped. You sign in with Google; only your name, email address and profile picture are requested, and each account sees only its own expenses. It records expenses only and never moves money, connects to bank accounts or gives financial advice. You can delete your account and all its data at any time by asking.
defaultPrompt: Add these: Uber 412.50 yesterday, Swiggy 486 on 2 Oct, and GitHub $4 on 1 Oct.
